Deepening Brand Relationships and Differentiated Product
Driving Continued Growth in Key Categories
Leveraging a Powerful Omni-channel Model and Accelerating Our eCommerce Channel
Capitalizing on Our Powerful Athlete Database
paragraphs: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries, referred to as "the Company", "we", "us" and "our" unless specified otherwise) is a leading global sports retailer offering an extensive assortment of authentic, high-quality sports equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories. Our banners include DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone! stores in addition to the experiential retail concepts DICK'S House of Sport and Golf Galaxy Performance Center which are all located across the United States. Additionally, as owner and operator of Foot Locker, which includes Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners, we serve the global sneaker community across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, plus a licensed store presence in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. We also own and operate GameChanger, a youth sports mobile platform for live streaming, scheduling, communications and scorekeeping.

We were founded in 1948 in New York under the name Dick's Clothing and Sporting Goods, Inc. when Richard "Dick" Stack, the father of Edward W. Stack, our Executive Chairman, opened his original bait and tackle store in Binghamton, New York. Edward W. Stack joined his father's business full-time in 1977 and in 1984 became President and Chief Executive Officer of the then two-store chain. In April 1999 we changed our name to DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc.

In fiscal 2025, the Company acquired Foot Locker, a leading footwear and apparel retailer, and now has two reportable segments: DICK'S and Foot Locker. When we refer to the "DICK'S Business" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, we are describing our existing DICK'S Sporting Goods operations, encompassing the DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Going Going Gone! and Public Lands banners, as well as GameChanger. Our employees are referred to as "teammates" and our customers are referred to as "athletes" for the DICK'S Business. When we refer to the "Foot Locker Business" we are describing our newly acquired operations, including the Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners serving customers referred to as "sneakerheads" or "sneaker enthusiasts." Foot Locker retail employees are often referred to as "stripers", or "blue shirts" in the context of the Champs Sports banner, and for all other employees, "teammates." For purposes of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, we use the general terms "customers" and "employees" when describing the consolidated organization. For additional information attributable to our reportable segments, refer to Part IV. Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules, Note 17 – Segment Reporting.

Our executive office is located at 345 Court Street, Coraopolis, Pennsylvania 15108 and our phone number is (724) 273-3400. Our website is located at www.dicks.com. The information on our website does not constitute a part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. We include on the investor relations portion of our website (www.investors.dicks.com), free of charge, copies of our Annual and Quarterly Reports on Forms 10-K and 10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act") as soon as reasonably practicable after their submission.

When used in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, unless the context otherwise requires or unless otherwise specified, any reference to "year" is to the Company's fiscal year, which ends on the Saturday closest to the end of January each year.

Since 1948, DICK'S has believed that sports have the power to change lives, and we are committed to bringing this belief to life through our strategic pillars of athlete experience, differentiated product, brand engagement, and most importantly, our teammates. With this belief as our foundation, our common purpose is to create confidence and excitement by inspiring, supporting, and personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. Driven by this common purpose and our commitment to all athletes, our mission is to:
•Create an inclusive environment where all teammates can thrive; •Create and build leading brands that serve and inspire athletes;
•Make a lasting impact on communities through sport; and
•Deliver shareholder value through growth and relentless improvement.
We believe that through pursuit of this mission and commitment to our four key strategic pillars in our DICK'S Business we can be the best sports company in the world.

We believe that our emphasis on an omni-channel athlete experience is fundamental to our growth and success in our DICK'S Business. We provide a wide range of in-store support services and have incorporated experiential in-store elements, powered by technology, to provide an elevated experience for our athletes. Experiential in-store elements such as HitTrax® batting cages, Trackman® golf simulators and our premium full-service footwear decks inspire confidence in our athletes and reinforce the power of our teammates' expertise. We also provide our athletes with a compelling visual presentation of our differentiated assortment through these premium full-service footwear decks, along with our branded shops, House of Cleats footwear presentation and elevated soccer shops to enhance their experience.

We continue to innovate our omni-channel athlete experience and grow our business through new store prototypes, while incorporating key learnings into the rest of our chain. Our DICK'S House of Sport stores provide highly experiential destinations for our athletes. These innovative formats are built around experience, service, community and product and drive strong engagement with our athletes, key brand partners and landlords, which we believe sets us apart as a clear market leader within the sporting goods industry. Additionally, we are incorporating House of Sport learnings into our most typical 50,000 square foot DICK'S store, which we are calling our DICK'S Field House concept and we launched our redesigned Golf Galaxy Performance Center in 2021, which are equipped with Trackman® golf technology and include an elevated staffing and service model to ensure our teammates become trusted advisors to golf enthusiasts of all levels.

At the heart of our elevated omni-channel athlete experience is our ongoing work to reposition our store portfolio through DICK'S House of Sport, DICK'S Field House and Golf Galaxy Performance Center. We opened 16 new DICK'S House of Sport locations during 2025, with 35 locations at the end of the year and plan to open approximately 14 locations in 2026. In addition, we plan to begin construction on approximately 18 DICK'S House of Sport locations that are expected to open in 2027. We opened 15 new DICK'S Field House store locations in 2025, ending the year with a total of 42 locations and plan to open approximately 22 locations in 2026. We have opened 33 Golf Galaxy Performance Centers to date, and we plan to open approximately 15 in 2026. We remain confident in the long-term potential of these concepts and the growth they will drive for the DICK'S Business.

We carry a full range of products within each category, including premium items for the sports enthusiast. We believe our compelling industry-leading product assortment in each sporting goods category offers our athletes a wide range of good, better and best price points and enables us to address the needs of our athletes, from beginner to sports enthusiast, which distinguishes us from other large format sporting goods stores. We focus on those growth categories in which we believe an opportunity to gain market share exists. We support these growth categories with greater quantities of enthusiast product and improved presentation and in-stock positions.

headings: Risks Related to Our Industry and Macroeconomic Conditions
Macroeconomic conditions may adversely affect consumer discretionary spending and our business, operations, liquidity, and financial results.
Intense competition in the sporting goods and retail industries could limit our growth and reduce our profitability.
Fluctuations in product costs and availability could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Risks Related to Our Operations and Reputation
If we are unable to anticipate or respond effectively to changes in consumer demand, preferences, fashion trends or shopping patterns, our sales and profitability may be adversely affected.
Harm to our reputation could adversely impact our ability to attract and retain customers and employees.

Our strategic plans and initiatives may initially result in a negative impact on our financial results, and such plans and initiatives may not achieve the desired results within the anticipated time frame or at all.
An inability to execute our real estate strategy could adversely affect our financial results.
Problems with our information systems could disrupt our operations and negatively impact our financial results and materially adversely affect our business operations.
We may be unable to attract, train, engage and retain key employees and to adequately respond to employee organizing efforts.
The seasonality of certain categories of our operations, along with the current geographic concentrations of our stores, exposes us to certain seasonal influences and weather-related risks.
We cannot provide any guaranty of future dividend payments or that we will continue to repurchase our common stock pursuant to our stock repurchase program.
If we do not successfully manage our inventory levels and protect against inventory shrink, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.
Risks Related to Our Common Stock, Class B Common Stock and Other Anti-Takeover Mechanisms
Failure to meet market expectations has caused, and could in the future cause, a decline in our common stock price.
We are controlled by holders of our Class B common stock, whose interests may differ from other stockholders.
Risks Related to Third Parties and Legal and Regulatory Requirements
We are subject to significant costs and risks associated with an extensive and evolving set of global laws and regulations that affect our business, operations, and workforce.
Our sales and operating results could be adversely affected by product safety and labeling concerns.
We may be subject to various types of litigation and other claims, and our insurance may not be sufficient to cover damages related to those claims.
Our inability to protect our intellectual property rights, or claims that we infringe the intellectual property rights of others, could adversely affect our brand, reputation, and operating results.
Changes to tax laws and regulations, or their interpretation and application, could adversely affect our financial results and condition.
Risks Related to Our Strategic Transactions, Indebtedness and Investments
paragraphs: Our business depends on consumer discretionary spending, and are sensitive to changes in global macroeconomic conditions outside of our control, including inflation, prolonged inflationary pressures and measures taken to curb inflation; elevated interest rates and recessionary pressures; changes in consumer disposable income consumer confidence and debt burdens; perceptions of global economic stability (including in response to shifts in government policies); and wage and unemployment levels. These conditions can cause consumers to reduce or postpone discretionary purchases, resulting in lower traffic, reduced comparable sales, and decreased average value per transaction across our business.

Geopolitical developments may also adversely affect our business and financial results. Ongoing conflicts and tensions —such as those in the Middle East (particularly the recent U.S. military operations in Iran), Ukraine and Venezuela—and the threat or outbreak of additional conflicts, war, terrorism, or public unrest may create economic instability, disrupt supply chains, increase fuel and transportation costs, or elevate cybersecurity risks. Such developments continue to introduce uncertainty regarding long‑term trade and economic conditions in the European Union and other markets, which may particularly affect our Foot Locker Business given its international footprint.

In response to reduced demand, we may need to increase promotional activity or adjust pricing strategies, which could negatively impact our planned sales levels and gross margins. A sustained reduction in consumer spending or an extended period of economic instability could adversely affect our business, operations, liquidity, financial condition, and results of operations.

We operate in a highly fragmented, intensely competitive and rapidly evolving global marketplace. We operate a number of different store formats and compete with an expanding set of retailers and other potential competitors across multiple formats and channels—including large-format, specialty and traditional retailers; mass merchants; department stores; and online and direct‑to‑consumer sellers, including vendors. Many of our competitors have significant international, national, regional, or local market presence, and their name recognition, and financial, marketing, technological, and other resources allow them to meaningfully compete with our business across various channels. Our ability to effectively and successfully respond to competitive pressures may adversely affect our results of operations, profitability or reputation.

Consumers can compare prices and product offerings in real time, increasing pressure on us to maintain competitive pricing, differentiated assortments and compelling marketing programs. If our varied marketing and advertising strategies, particularly across digital and social media channels, are unsuccessful, we could lose customers and experience declining sales. In addition, the retail industry is undergoing continued technological innovation and disruption—including increased use of artificial intelligence ("AI") and machine learning. If we cannot innovate, enhance our platforms or adopt new technologies at a pace consistent with consumer expectations and industry developments, our business could be harmed.

Our product costs depend in part on the cost and availability of raw materials and component inputs. Significant increases in those costs—whether due to trade tensions, shifting tariff policies in key sourcing countries like China, Mexico, and Canada (including recently enacted tariffs and potential additional shifts in tariff policies in the future), currency fluctuations, material shortages, supply chain disruptions, or other factors—could increase manufacturing and other costs for both our own private brand merchandise and the products we purchase from our vendors. These factors could also compel us to seek alternative suppliers, take pricing actions, modify operations, or take other actions that may not fully mitigate the associated cost increases, and our sales, margins, and profitability could be adversely affected.

paragraphs: We are a leading global sports retailer offering an extensive assortment of authentic, high-quality sports equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories. Our banners include DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone! stores in addition to the experiential retail concepts DICK'S House of Sport and Golf Galaxy Performance Center which are all located across the United States. Additionally, as owner and operator of Foot Locker, which includes Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners, we serve the global sneaker community across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, plus a licensed store presence in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. We also own and operate GameChanger, a youth sports mobile platform for live streaming, scheduling, communications and scorekeeping. When used in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, unless the context otherwise requires or specifies, any reference to "year" is to our fiscal year, which ends on the Saturday closest to the end of January each year.

When we refer to the "DICK'S Business" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K (this "10-K Report"), we are describing our existing DICK'S Sporting Goods operations, encompassing the DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Going Going Gone! and Public Lands banners, as well as GameChanger. When we refer to the "Foot Locker Business" we are describing our newly acquired Foot Locker operations, including the Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners.

Through our strategic pillars of athlete experience, differentiated product, brand engagement and teammate experience, we have transformed our DICK'S Business to drive sustained profitable growth. As part of our strategy, we have meaningfully improved our merchandise assortment through our vertical brands and strong relationships with our key brand partners, which provide access to highly differentiated products. We have also enhanced our store selling culture and service model and incorporated additional experiential elements and technology into our stores to further engage our athletes. We continue to innovate our omni-channel athlete experience through our DICK'S House of Sport stores, Golf Galaxy Performance Centers and our DICK'S Field House stores, and believe that a key driver of our future omni-channel growth will include repositioning our store portfolio to grow these stores. In addition to these strategies and foundational improvements, consumers have also made what we believe will be lasting lifestyle changes in recent years, prioritizing sport and maintaining healthy, active lifestyles, which has increased demand for our products.

We believe there is strength and momentum in the sports industry in the United States and expect this trend to continue in the near term, with continued excitement around women's sports, the 2026 FIFA World Cup and the 2028 Olympics. We believe that the convergence of sport and culture has never been stronger and that we are well-positioned for this opportunity. From this position of strength, we plan to continue to make investments in digital and in-store opportunities to further grow our market share through repositioning our store portfolio, driving continued growth across our key categories and accelerating our eCommerce channel.

paragraphs: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc.（含其子公司，簡稱為 "the Company"、"we"、"us" 及 "our"，除非另有說明）為全球領先的運動商品零售商，提供廣泛的正規、高品質運動器材、服飾、鞋類及配件。我們的零售品牌包括 DICK'S Sporting Goods、Golf Galaxy、Public Lands 及 Going Going Gone! 等商店，以及體驗式零售概念 DICK'S House of Sport 及 Golf Galaxy Performance Center，皆位於美國各地。此外，作為 Foot Locker 的所有者與營運者，包含 Foot Locker、Kids Foot Locker、Champs Sports、WSS 及 atmos 等品牌，我們服務北美洲、歐洲、亞洲及澳洲的全球鞋類愛好者，並在歐洲、中東及亞洲設有授權商店。我們亦擁有 GameChanger，為一針對青少年運動的行動平台，提供直播、排程、溝通及比分紀錄功能。

我們於 1948 年在紐約成立，當時名為 Dick's Clothing and Sporting Goods, Inc.，由 Richard "Dick" Stack 所創立，他是 Edward W. Stack，我們的執行董事長之父，於紐約賓漢頓開設了他的原廠釣具商店。Edward W. Stack 於 1977 年開始全職加入父親的業務，並於 1984 年成為當時僅有兩間店的連鎖品牌總裁與首席執行官。1999 年 4 月，我們將公司名稱改為 DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc.

在 2025 年財務年度，本公司取得 Foot Locker，為一領先的鞋類與服飾零售商，目前擁有兩個應報告分部：DICK'S 及 Foot Locker。當我們在本 10-K 年度報告中提及 "DICK'S 商業" 時，我們指的是我們現有的 DICK'S Sporting Goods 運營業務，包含 DICK'S Sporting Goods、Golf Galaxy、Going Going Gone! 及 Public Lands 等品牌，以及 GameChanger。我們的員工被稱為 "teammates"，而我們的客戶則被稱為 "athletes"，針對 DICK'S 商業。當我們提及 "Foot Locker 商業" 時，我們指的是我們新近取得的運營業務，包含 Foot Locker、Kids Foot Locker、Champs Sports、WSS 及 atmos 等品牌，服務的客戶被稱為 "sneakerheads" 或 "sneaker enthusiasts"。Foot Locker 的零售員工常被稱為 "stripers"，或在 Champs Sports 品牌下稱為 "blue shirts"，而其他員工則稱為 "teammates"。為本 10-K 年度報告之目的，我們在描述整體組織時，使用一般用語 "客戶" 及 "員工"。如需更多關於我們應報告分部的資訊，請參閱第四部分 第 15 項 附屬文件及財務會計表附表，附註 17 – 分部報告。

我們的總部位於賓夕法尼亞州科羅波利斯市法院街 345 號，電話為 (724) 273-3400。我們的網站為 www.dicks.com。網站上的資訊不構成本年度報告 10-K 的一部分。我們在網站的投資者關係頁面（www.investors.dicks.com）免費提供年度及季度報告，格式為 10-K 及 10-Q，以及 8-K 現況報告及其修正版本，這些報告根據 1934 年證券交易法（經修正）（"Exchange Act"）提交後盡速提供。
當本年度報表（Form 10-K）中使用 "year" 一詞時，除非上下文另有說明或另有明確界定，否則均指本公司會計年度，該會計年度為每年一月最後一個星期六。
自1948年起，DICK'S 相信運動有改變人生的力量，我們致力於透過我們的戰略支柱：運動員體驗、差異化產品、品牌參與，以及最重要的是我們的隊友，來實現這項信念。以這項信念為基礎，我們的共同目標是透過激勵、支持並親身協助所有運動員實現他們的夢想，來創造信心與熱情。基於這個共同目標與我們對所有運動員的承諾，我們的使命為：
•建立一個包容的環境，讓所有隊友都能發揚光大；•建立並發展領導品牌的運動員服務與啟發；
•透過運動對社區產生深遠的影響；
•透過成長與持續改善來創造股東價值。
我們相信，透過追求此使命並對我們在 DICK'S 商業中的四大關鍵戰略支柱保持承諾，我們可以成為全球最佳的運動用品公司。

我們相信，我們對全通路運動員體驗的重視，是我們在 DICK'S 商業中成長與成功的基礎。我們提供廣泛的門市支持服務，並透過科技驅動的體驗式門市元素，為運動員提供更升級的體驗。這些體驗式門市元素，例如 HitTrax® 打擊籠、Trackman® 高爾夫模擬器以及我們的高階完整服務鞋類展示區，能提升運動員的信心，並強化我們隊友專業知識的價值。我們也透過這些高階完整服務鞋類展示區，為運動員提供我們差異化產品組合的強烈視覺呈現，並搭配我們的品牌商店、House of Cleats 鞋類展示與升級版足球商店，以增強他們的體驗。

我們持續創新我們的全通路運動員體驗，並透過新門市原型來擴大業務，同時將關鍵學習成果應用於整個門市體系。我們的 DICK'S House of Sport 門市為運動員提供高度體驗化的場所。這些創新形式以體驗、服務、社羣與產品為核心，並能強化我們與運動員、關鍵品牌合作夥伴及租賃方的互動，我們相信這使我們在運動用品行業中成為明確的市場領導者。此外，我們也將 House of Sport 的學習成果應用於我們最常見的 50,000 平方英尺 DICK'S 門市，我們稱之為 DICK'S Field House 概念，並於 2021 年啟動了重新設計的 Golf Galaxy Performance Center，這些門市配備 Trackman® 高爾夫科技，並採用升級的員工配置與服務模式，以確保我們的隊友成為各層級高爾夫愛好者的值得信賴的顧問。

我們升級的全通路運動員體驗的核心，是我們持續透過 DICK'S House of Sport、DICK'S Field House 和 Golf Galaxy Performance Center 來重新定位門市組合。我們於 2025 年開設了 16 個新的 DICK'S House of Sport 門市，截至年底總共有 35 個門市，並預計於 2026 年開設約 14 個門市。此外，我們預計開始興建約 18 個 DICK'S House of Sport 門市，預計於 2027 年開幕。我們於 2025 年開設了 15 個新的 DICK'S Field House 門市，截至年底總共有 42 個門市，並預計於 2026 年開設約 22 個門市。截至目前為止，我們已開設了 33 個 Golf Galaxy Performance Center，並預計於 2026 年開設約 15 個。我們對這些概念的長期潛力以及它們將為 DICK'S 商業帶來的成長保持信心。
我們在每個產品類別中皆提供完整的產品組合，包括為運動愛好者提供的高階商品。我們相信，我們在每個運動用品類別中強大的行業領先產品組合，能為運動員提供廣泛的優質、優越與最佳價格點，並使我們能滿足從初學者到運動愛好者的所有運動員需求，這使我們與其他大型運動用品商店有所區別。我們專注於那些我們認為有機會獲取市場份額的成長類別。我們透過提供更多的愛好者產品、改善展示與庫存狀況來支持這些成長類別。

paragraphs: 本公司為全球領先的運動商品零售商，提供廣泛的正規、高品質運動器材、服飾、鞋類及配件。我們的旗艦店包括DICK'S Sporting Goods、Golf Galaxy、Public Lands及Going Going Gone!，此外還有體驗式零售概念商店DICK'S House of Sport及Golf Galaxy Performance Center，皆位於美國各地。此外，作為Foot Locker的擁有者及營運者，包含Foot Locker、Kids Foot Locker、Champs Sports、WSS及atmos旗艦店，我們服務北美、歐洲、亞洲及澳洲的全球鞋類愛好者，並在歐洲、中東及亞洲擁有授權門市。本公司亦擁有並營運GameChanger，這是一個為青少年運動提供的行動平台，用於即時串流、排程、溝通及比分紀錄。當在本年度10-K報告中使用"year"一詞時，除非上下文另有說明，否則均指本公司會計年度，即每年一月最後一個星期六。

當在本年度10-K報告中提及"DICK'S Business"時，我們指的是現有DICK'S Sporting Goods營運，包含DICK'S Sporting Goods、Golf Galaxy、Going Going Gone!及Public Lands旗艦店，以及GameChanger。當提及"Foot Locker Business"時，我們指的是本公司新近取得的Foot Locker營運，包含Foot Locker、Kids Foot Locker、Ch.amps Sports、WSS及atmos旗艦店。

透過我們的戰略支柱：運動員體驗、差異化產品、品牌互動及隊友體驗，我們已將DICK'S Business轉型，以推動可持續的獲利成長。根據我們的策略，我們已透過自有品牌及與關鍵品牌合作夥伴的強大關係，大幅改善商品種類，提供高度差異化的產品。我們也提升了商店銷售文化與服務模式，並在商店中加入更多體驗元素與科技，以進一步與運動員互動。我們持續創新全通路運動員體驗，透過DICK'S House of Sport商店、Golf Galaxy Performance Centers及DICK'S Field House商店，我們相信未來全通路成長的關鍵驅動因素將包括重新定位商店組合，以擴大這些商店的規模。除了這些策略與基礎改善外，消費者也於近年做出我們認為將持續的永續生活方式改變，優先考慮運動並維持健康活躍的生活方式，這已提高對我們產品的需求。
我們相信美國運動產業有強勁的成長動能與動力，並預期此趨勢在近期內將持續，包括對女子運動的熱情、2026年國際足總世界盃及2028年奧運的期待。我們認為運動與文化的結合從來沒有如此強烈，而我們也處於有利位置以把握這個機會。從這個強勢的基礎出發，我們計畫持續投資於數位與實體商店的機會，以進一步擴大市場佔有率，透過重新定位商店組合、推動關鍵類別的持續成長，並加速電商通路。

headings: 與我們產業及總體經濟相關的風險
總體經濟情況可能不利於消費者非必要支出及我們的業務、營運、流動性及財務結果。
運動器材及零售產業中的激烈競爭可能限制我們的成長並降低我們的獲利能力。
產品成本與供應的波動可能不利於我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果。
與我們營運及聲譽相關的風險
若我們無法有效預測或回應消費者需求、偏好、時尚趨勢或購物模式的變化，我們的銷售與獲利能力可能受到不利影響。
我們聲譽的損害可能不利於我們吸引及留住客戶與員工的能力。
我們的戰略計畫與措施可能在初期對我們的財務結果造成負面影響，且這些計畫與措施可能無法在預期時間內或完全達成預期的結果。
無法執行我們的不動產策略，可能會對我們的財務結果造成不利影響。
我們的資訊系統若出現問題，可能會干擾我們的營運，並對財務結果造成負面影響，且可能嚴重影響我們的業務營運。
我們可能無法吸引、培訓、激勵並留住關鍵員工，並對員工組織活動做出適當回應。
我們某些營運類別的季節性，以及目前門店的地理集中度，使我們面臨某些季節性影響及天氣相關風險。
我們無法提供未來發放紅利的保證，或我們將持續根據股票回購計畫回購普通股的保證。
若我們無法成功管理存貨水準並防範存貨虧損，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。
與我們普通股、B類普通股及其他反 takeover 機制相關的風險
未能達到市場預期，已導致並可能在未來導致我們普通股價格下跌。
本公司由持有我們Class B普通股之股東所控制，其利益可能與其他股東不同。
與第三方及法律與法規要求相關之風險
本公司需面對與廣泛且不斷演進之全球法律與法規相關之重大成本與風險，這些法律與法規影響我們之業務、運作及員工。
產品安全與標籤問題可能對我們之銷售與營運結果產生負面影響。
我們可能面臨各種類型之訴訟及其他聲請，且我們之保險可能不足以彌補與這些聲請相關之損害。
我們若無法保護我們之智慧財產權，或遭他人聲請我們侵權，可能對我們之品牌、聲譽及營運結果產生負面影響。
稅法與法規之變更，或其解釋與適用，可能對我們之財務結果與財務狀況產生負面影響。
與我們之戰略交易、負債及投資相關之風險
paragraphs: 本公司業務依賴消費者非必需性支出，且對全球總體經濟條件的變化敏感，這些變化超出本公司控制範圍，包括通貨膨脹、持續的通貨膨脹壓力及抑制通貨膨脹的措施；高利率及經濟衰退壓力；消費者可支配所得、消費者信心及債務負擔的變化；對全球經濟穩定性的看法（包括對政府政策變動的反應）；以及工資及失業率水平。這些條件可能導致消費者減少或延後非必需性購買，造成本公司的客流量減少、可比銷售額下降，以及每筆交易的平均價值降低。

地緣政治發展也可能對本公司業務及財務結果產生不利影響。持續的衝突與緊張局勢—例如中東地區（特別是美國在伊朗的軍事行動）、烏克蘭及委內瑞拉—以及可能發生或爆發的其他衝突、戰爭、恐怖主義或公共動亂，可能造成經濟不穩定、幹擾供應鏈、提高燃料及運輸成本，或增加網路安全風險。這些發展持續引入對歐盟及其他市場長期貿易及經濟條件的不確定性，這可能特別影響本公司 Foot Locker 商業業務，因其國際業務版圖廣泛。
面對需求減少，本公司可能需要增加促銷活動或調整價格策略，這可能會對本公司預期的銷售水準及毛利率產生負面影響。消費者支出持續減少或經濟不穩定持續一段時間，可能會對本公司業務、營運、流動性、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。

本公司營運於一個高度分散、競爭激烈且快速變化的全球市場。本公司營運多種不同店鋪格式，並與擴展中的零售商及其他潛在競爭者在多種格式及通路中競爭—including大型商店、專業商店及傳統零售商；折扣零售商；百貨公司；以及線上及直銷零售商，包括供應商。許多競爭對手擁有廣泛的國際、國家、區域或地方市場存在，他們的品牌知名度及財務、行銷、科技及其他資源，使其能在不同通路中與本公司業務進行有效競爭。本公司能否有效且成功地應對競爭壓力，可能對本公司營運結果、獲利能力或聲譽產生不利影響。

消費者可以實時比較價格及產品選擇，增加本公司維持競爭性價格、差異化商品組合及吸引人的行銷方案的壓力。如果本公司多樣化的行銷及廣告策略，特別是在數位及社交媒體通路上的策略失敗，本公司可能會失去客戶並遭遇銷售額下降。此外，零售業正在經歷持續的科技創新與變革—including增加的人工智慧（"AI"）及機器學習的應用。如果本公司無法創新、提升平台或採用新科技的速度與消費者期望及產業發展一致，本公司業務可能會受到損害。

本公司產品成本部分取決於原材料及零組件的價格及可得性。這些成本的顯著增加—無論是因貿易緊張局勢、關鍵來源國家如中國、墨西哥及加拿大（包括最近實施的關稅及未來可能的關稅政策變動）、貨幣波動、材料短缺、供應鏈中斷或其他因素—可能會提高本公司自有品牌商品及其他從供應商購入產品的製造及其他成本。這些因素也可能促使本公司尋求替代供應商、採取價格措施、調整營運，或採取其他措施，這些措施可能無法完全抵消相關成本增加，而本公司銷售額、毛利率及獲利能力可能受到不利影響。
